experiment_note: RT60 final-contrast-readout loads the exact RT59-v3 epoch-8 weight-only parent, freezes every parameter and buffer except the six tensors in pga_anchor_residual_transport_head.transport.residual_head, and trains those 67,077 scalars for exactly eight new epochs. The immutable same-forward RT59 readout is stored in checkpoint metadata; the old RT57 gamma=1.66 val_rt59_base_* meaning is unchanged. The objective replaces all RT59 auxiliaries with grouped point loss, remote-only parent regret and final-field contrast. No held-out test split is used.
station_filter_note: source_network=knt only. The converted shards already contain corrected origin time/provenance, aligned P picks, log10 PGA in m/s^2, record_start_sample + valid_n_samples, and VS30. No origin-correction or DPK preprocessing is required after upload.

pga_target_normalization.source: 2000-2024 default event-level train split, source_network=knt, finite pga_norm_resampled_mps2
